why: Provide reusable proof rules and control parts for independent courses.
Clarify the purpose of the assumption box in Chinese

ops.value: 假设框用来证明「若 A，则 B」。在「假设」栏设定 A，然后在框内以 A 为临时前提证明 B。将证出的 B 接到「结论」端口，框外便得到 A \mark{implies} B。

value.en: A box, with A set on the part. Inside, A may be used as an assumption; prove B there and wire it to “Conclusion”, and the part gives A \mark{implies} B.
value.zh: 带一个框，A 在元件上设定。框内可以使用假设 A；框内证出 B 并接到「结论」，元件输出 A \mark{implies} B。

why: Boxes take their own names: the for-any box chooses only a sentence letter, induction takes its number itself
Copy: boxes take their own names

value.zh: 框为任意对象取一个新名字，例如 a：它所在的框和已知都没有用过这个名字。在框内证明 P(a) 并接到「结论」，框外得到 \mark{forall}x. P(x)。
value.en: The box gives an arbitrary object a new name, such as a, that no box around it and no premise uses. Prove P(a) inside the box and connect it to “Conclusion” to obtain \mark{forall}x. P(x) outside.

value.zh: 带两个框，证元件上选定的 \mark{forall}x. P(x)。第一个框证 P(0)；第二个框为其中的数取一个新名字，例如 a，可以使用假设 P(a)，要证 P(S a)。两个框都证完，元件输出 \mark{forall}x. P(x)。
value.en: Two boxes, proving the \mark{forall}x. P(x) chosen on the part. The first proves P(0); the second gives its number a new name, such as a, may use the assumption P(a), and proves P(S a). Once both are proved, the part gives \mark{forall}x. P(x).

Two boxes, proving the \mark{forall}x. P(x) chosen on the part. The first proves P(0); in the second the number is called a (named on the part; it must not occur in any open assumption), P(a) may be used as an assumption, and P(S a) is to be proved. Once both are proved, the part gives \mark{forall}x. P(x).
value.zh: 带两个框，证元件上选定的 \mark{forall}x. P(x)。第一个框证 P(0)；第二个框内的数记作 a（在元件上命名，不能出现在未解除的假设中），可以使用假设 P(a)，要证 P(S a)。两个框都证完，元件输出 \mark{forall}x. P(x)。

value.en: Name an arbitrary object a on the part. Prove P(a) inside the box and connect it to “Conclusion” to obtain \mark{forall}x. P(x) outside. a must not occur in any open assumption.
value.zh: 在元件上为任意对象取名 a，在框内证明 P(a) 并接到「结论」，框外得到 \mark{forall}x. P(x)。a 不能出现在未解除的假设中。
